extracted.name: Cake Mix Spice Cookies
extracted.description: Use a box of spice cake mix, eggs, oil, raisins, and walnuts to make these quick and easy spice cake mix cookies.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Beat cake mix, eggs, and oil together in a bowl to form a thick batter. Fold raisins and walnuts into batter; drop by large spoonfuls onto a baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until tops are no longer moist, 9 to 12 minutes.
